description:
Mi Account
Has a LOT of permissions + Facebook trackers. Collects many information, including your phone number, your unique International mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) and your clipboard).
You should remove this if you don't have or don't want a Mi account.
WARNING: Make sure to log out of your Mi Account and unbind your phone from it. If you don't you could be locked out from your phone after removing this package.
Remove Mi Account: https://xiaomiui.net/how-to-remove-mi-account-7606/

Pithus analysis: https://beta.pithus.org/report/3f5abc9d7215dd0be5c3ac137b0cd528217640b5778e9f849a9beb0a34eda8dc
